serviceDisclosure.title: Exactly what our service covers
serviceDisclosure.subtitle: Full transparency before any commitment. Payment is made in person at our office — no payment transaction takes place on this website.

included.title: Included in the Darb service fee
items: Academic consultation and selection of the right field of study and universities.
Preparation and review of your application file, and coordination of certificate translation and recognition.
Submitting applications to universities and following up until a decision is issued.
Preparing your visa file and getting you ready for the embassy or consulate appointment.
Arabic-language guidance and support throughout the process via the student dashboard.

excluded.title: Not included in the Darb service fee
items: Official fees: visa application fees, university and uni-assist fees, certification and sworn translation fees.
The blocked account (Sperrkonto) and the proof-of-funds amount itself.
Health insurance premiums.
Accommodation costs, deposits and first month's rent.
Flights, living costs and transport.

providers.title: Who actually provides each part
items: Darb: consultation, file preparation, submission, follow-up and administrative support. Darb is an intermediary and guide, not a decision-making authority.
The university / uni-assist: the admission decision, its conditions and its fees — entirely independent of Darb.
The German embassy or consulate and the foreigners authority: the visa and residence-permit decision — entirely independent of Darb.
The insurer: the health insurance contract is concluded directly between you and the insurance company, which is responsible for its terms and coverage.
The accommodation provider: the housing contract is concluded directly between you and the landlord or provider, who is responsible for the deposit and terms.

noGuarantee.title: No guarantee of outcome
noGuarantee.body: Darb provides professional guidance and file preparation. We cannot guarantee that you will receive university admission, a visa, or accommodation, because those decisions rest solely with independent official bodies. Paying the service fee does not constitute a guarantee of any outcome.

payment.title: How payment works
payment.body: No payment is processed through this website. Fees are agreed, the agreement is signed, and payment is made in person at the Darb office. You receive a written breakdown of the fee and what it covers before you pay.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and refunds — in plain language
items: You may cancel the agreement at any time with written notice (email is sufficient).
If you cancel before work on your file has started, you receive a full refund.
If you cancel after work has started, you are refunded minus the value of the work actually performed and any official third-party fees already paid on your behalf (which are non-refundable).
A university or visa rejection is not a breach by Darb; refunds in that case follow the rule above.
Approved refund requests are processed within 14 business days.
For any cancellation or refund request: darbsocial27@gmail.com.
